name: Tony Standen
story: Tony Standen served as NZEUG’s deputy chair at its fifteenth AGM, held at Wellington Town Hall on 10 November 2010. The project-held minutes record that the executive remained unchanged after the election.

Tony Standen, Team Leader Information Delivery at New Plymouth District Council, was handling the conference call for papers, while Junior Lee-Chee, Maps and Designs Manager at Auckland City Council, collected votes on the conference's future.
